text.en:
Act Numbered Twenty-one hundred and twenty-one of the Philippine Legislature, enacted
February first, nineteen hundred and twelve, entitled "An Act amending Act Numbered Eight hundred and
seventeen by changing the method of appointment of locust boards and by defining the relation of the Bureau
of Agriculture to the locust boards, and appropriating a sum of money for the purposes of said Act, and for
other purposes," except section four thereof, is hereby extended to and made applicable in the territory
inhabited by Moms or other non-Christian tribes.

For the purpose of carrying out the provisions of this Act in said territory there is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated the sum of five thousand
pesos annually: Provided, however. That the unexpended balance of any year shall revert to the Insular

The duties of provincial boards under said Act Numbered Twenty-one hundred and twenty-one
shall be performed in the Moro Province by the legislative council.

This Act shall take effect as of July first, nineteen hundred and twelve.
Enacted, September 17, 1912.
